headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way on the mound. Cole pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list. Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. The Seattle Mariners have placed RHP Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins have placed RHP Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, due to a left glute strain. The Cleveland Guardians have placed RHP Slade Cecconi on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue. The Chicago White Sox have placed LHP Chris Murphy on the 15-day injured list due to a left flexor strain and C Joey Bart on the 10-day injured list due to a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand. The Toronto Blue Jays have placed 2B Luis Urías on the 10-day injured list due to a right quad strain.

Several teams have made roster moves. The Kansas City Royals have acquired first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. The Athletics have acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit a home run and drove in two runs, while Aaron Nola pitched 5.0 innings with 8 strikeouts for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status on the injured list will be reassessed in 10 days.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being previously traded to the team.
